docs.word: Letters then decimal digits, per general category.

source:
## Semantics: U3 (rs#297) — general-category classes. %p{L} and
## %p{Nd} compile to the regex category class; both engines carry the
## tables and the fixture pins the agreement across scripts (Han,
## Latin-1, Cyrillic, Arabic-Indic digits).
grammar ConformanceUnicodeCategories version "1.0.0" mode "classic" {
  ## Letters then decimal digits, per general category.
  word = 1*%p{L} as word
  code = 1*%p{Nd} as code
  pair = word %x20 code

  entry main: pair

  test main {
    accept "日本語 ٠١٢"
    accept "café 012"
    accept "ДОН 42"
    reject "1x 12"
    reject "café x"
  }
}
